create_scan_dataset_builder: create a tfds dataset builder for the SCAN dataset with configurable split types
build_scan_config: build a ScanConfig for a specific SCAN split like simple, length, or mcd1
generate_scan_examples: generate examples from SCAN dataset files with commands and actions pairs
read_scan_examples: read SCAN dataset examples from a tasks file parsing IN/OUT command-action pairs
split_scan_dataset: split the SCAN dataset into train and test splits using splitfiles or separate files
